claims.statement: The Reverb engine has kNumModes = 6 in V2 mode order (Plate 0, Spring 1, Room 2, Chamber 3, Hall 4, Digital 5; Reverb.h case 0..5). Decay caps kMaxDecayMsByMode[6] = {2500 (Plate), 2500 (Spring), 2000 (Room), 3000 (Chamber), 3500 (Hall), 2750 (Digital)} ms, clamped EXACTLY at the user's stated onset (stabilised above by a decay-gated HF softener kSoftenerAmt = 0.12). enterMode default dials: Plate (mode 0, '140' instance) NEUTRAL 50% tone/size/width, decay 2000 ms = the EMT 140 2.0 s reference length (tuning target, 2026-10-13); Spring decay 2000 / tone 0.60 / size 0.60 / width 0.90 (the user's ears); Room 500 ms / 0.40 / 0.30 / 0.70; Chamber 1800 / 1.0 pre / 0.50 / 0.45 / 0.85; Hall 3000 / 2.0 pre / 0.60 / 0.90 / 0.95; Digital default dials per defaultDialsForMode.

MODE/SUBTYPE (type) tuning rule — GENERAL across all effects (plate/'140' is the instance): a mode + model/subtype (Params::type[mode] axis, numTypes(), defaultDialsForType(), UI type chip e.g. the '140' Plate chip = mode 0 type 0 in V2 mode order) MAY carry its own knob defaults and its own tone law tuned against its own reference IR — permissive (CAN, not MUST) — but it must NEVER override the generic/shared path or the OTHER modes (bit-identical pins keep them separate: shared comb lines, norm/wash, convolver, and 15-digit pins for every other mode). defaultDialsForType currently returns false (no type override shipped yet). The same rule applies to delay subtypes (Straight/Mod/BBD/Mem), compressor subtypes, chorus/tape subtypes — each may have its own defaults and law (tuned to ITS reference) provided the generic path stays separate.

Spring (mode 1) metallic body + boing: the incommensurate resonator cluster (kSpringR1..R3 gains, IR-driven ears-pass — the 1.3–2.8 kHz pings lifted ~+4 dB RELATIVE to the 220–900 Hz body modes, ping + sparkle) replaces the old single-2-kHz boing ring, which is DISABLED (kSpringBoingGain = 0.000, 'replaced by the R1/R2/R3 cluster'; earlier value 0.028). Body gain kSpringBodyGain = 0.018 (modest — 'body is under the metal, not over it').

Plate/'140' (mode 0 in V2 mode order, type 0 = EMT 140 model) is tuned against the EMT 140 2.0 s IR convolved through the house BudgetConvolver, BOTH sides peak-normalised, with the reference's OWN numbers measured first (the reference itself drifts +4.85 dB and carries 4.3 dB of steady comb, so the guard must pass for the reference). SHIPPED constants (2026-10-13 final pass): air law kPlateAirHzBright = 4900, kPlateAirHzDark = 3600, kPlateAirStages = 2 (two 1st-order OUT-stage LPF stages, -6 dB/oct each; LONGER = DARKER is the MEASURED direction across the EMT 140 family hflf -27.9 to -34.9 dB over 1.0 to 2.5 s); body kPlateBodyHz = 550, kPlateBodyDb = 1.30, kPlateBodyQ = 0.60; onset 3 taps kPlateOnsetDelayMs = {14.2, 26.9, 51.3} ms, kPlateOnsetAmps = {0.42, 0.30, 0.16} (sum 0.88; the 2026-10-13 final pass replaced the 5-tap bank {12.7, 19.3, 27.8, 43.1, 58.4} sum 1.17 + whip 0.026), kPlateOnsetLpA = 0.33 (~2.5 kHz fizz safety), kPlateBrightOnset = 0.015 (lowered from 0.026; the whip FLOOR under the pings); dwell kPlatePresence = 1.189 (+1.5 dB wet dwell, the user-confirmed LOWER-dwell member of the Plate/Spring pair); wash kPlateWashAp = 0.62 / kPlateWashRef = 0.244; bloom kPlateBloomFrac = 0.32; kPlateColorAmt = 0.3 (OFF: soft-shoulder removed). Guard re-pins at the final state (plate_texture_tests.cpp): level baseline 78.23 (was 83.5977, within the +/-1 dB guard), comb baseline 19.39 (was 20.31, within the model-baseline+1 dB guard); all other five reverb modes bit-identical; DspTests green (470/470 as of the 2026-10-13 R1 reverbDry addition).

CONSIDERED & DECLINED (2026-10-13 final pass; keep the full block; do NOT re-try blind): (1) in-loop darkening/body (comb +4.7 to +10 dB, fb-capped gain, one unstable); (2) 2nd-order biquad out-stages at low fc MEASURED UNSTABLE (unnormalised peaking; pole radius 1.127 to NaN), DC-DEAD (lowpass form DC gain 0.035 = a resonator not a lowpass; 6-12 kHz passed uncut), or wrong-shape (a 240 Hz peaking at 600 Hz-1.2 kHz) -- ONLY 1st-order stages (y += a*(x-y), a = 1-exp(-2*pi*fc/fs)) are stable and DC-exact; if ever required: JUCE BiquadCoefficients AND numeric pole radius < 1 AND DC gain checks before shipping; (3) body-ADD out-stage (worked +4 dB but 50 % NEUTRAL rebalance already reproduces the EMT body -- REMOVED); (4) denser onset pings: L1 dense-9-tap bank 42.7 to 29.5, Hadamard 42.7 to 25.1 (more in-band energy = higher floor = thinner peaks); (5) C3 near-miss (5 uneven taps sum 1.14, whip 0.026 KEPT): only +2.5 dB ping (37.15 to 39.70) vs C (3 taps, whip 0.015: 37.15 to 45.66, within 0.9 dB of ref 46.60) -- the lever is the FLOOR (kPlateBrightOnset), not tap count or sum; (6) extra series-LPF stage for Size law (can only darken -- wrong direction for size 1 = brighter; its low-band swamps the body at high-freq tail offsets -- rejected in favor of the corner shift kPlateSizeCornerFrac); (7) trained M/S split (the Haas-offset mechanism already gives a documented bounded image, S-M -4.06 dB at width 1.0; a mid/side gain would be an unmeasured constant -- documented as the model's MEASURED difference instead); (8) value-matching the reference comb (19.39 vs EMT 140's 14.71: different cavity physics; the model's own comb law -- growth with its own decay -- is pinned relative to its own baseline per ticket no-forced-match).

The Size dial (params_.size) was a NO-OP on the Plate path (mode 0 in V2 order) -- the 2026-10-13 user redirect: make it mean plate-class, not an arbitrary knob. SHIPPED law: a corner shift on the air-law two-stage LPF (kPlateSizeCornerFrac = 0.30 of the 4900-to-3600 Hz air-law range, +/-780 Hz per unit size) set in Reverb::setParams: sizeDelta = (0.5 - params_.size) * 2.0 * kPlateSizeCornerFrac; airFrac = jlimit(0,1, frac - sizeDelta); fc = kPlateAirHzBright - (kPlateAirHzBright - kPlateAirHzDark) * airFrac. MEASURED direction (hflf 6-12k vs 120-300 Hz @0.4-0.6 s, 2.0 s decay): size 0.0 = -59.9 dB, size 0.5 = -46.7 dB, size 1.0 = -35.3 dB -- size 1 (LARGE-PLATE class) is BRIGHTER, size 0 (compact) is DARKER; the first-draft physics guess (bigger = darker) was backwards and the measurement won. At size 0.5 sizeDelta = 0.0, so airLp_ is bit-identical to the pre-size-law 140 tuning (anchor). Guards (plate_family_tests.cpp SizeLaw): monotone brightening s1 > s5 > s0 (measured) and no comb growth at either extreme (comb 0.0=6.10, 0.5=19.39, 1.0=21.74; guard 19.39+1 dB at size 1). TODO (future ticket, NOT shipped): Chamber, Hall, and Digital reverb paths ALSO never read params_.size -- audit those paths the same way.

Each effect mode is a distinct DSP engine, not a preset, and its per-mode law + every CONSIDERED-&-DECLINED item in docs/agents/dsp-invariants.md and docs/agents/ir-reverb-training.md is a user-eared CONTRACT pinned by tests in test/src/: effect_tests.cpp, convolution_reverb_tests.cpp, plate_comb_tests.cpp, plate_texture_tests.cpp, plate_family_tests.cpp (2026-10-13 final pass: P1 family table, P2 cross-model, P4 knob laws incl. SizeLaw, P5 stereo image, P6 cap/CPU), budget_convolver_cost_tests.cpp, and more -- do NOT silently simplify the law back to a naive form (e.g. Compressor ratio law: detent 4:1 is the bit-identical keeper anchor; do NOT simplify to (n-1)/R which treated R as softness = INVERTED; chorus/tremolo kNumWaves must stay 5 together; 1-pole 80 Hz highpass pole = 1-a not a; BBD fc ~ 1/T from the SLEWED base tap, 5 kHz at 250 ms reference, clamped 50 Hz..Nyquist; lane-aware spread formula side = (lane_ + ch) >= 1). The delay design lives in plugin/docs/delay-modes.md; the IR training protocol + the plate/'140' instance + the biquad landmine live in docs/agents/ir-reverb-training.md.
